vulnerable_statements.reason: The parent paging HWPT is validated only for auto_domain/nest_parent, but not that its domain was allocated by the same IOMMU driver (parent->common.domain->owner == ops). A user can pass a nest parent created on a device behind a different IOMMU driver/instance, and the parent domain is then handed to this device's driver.

The driver's domain_alloc_user casts the parent iommu_domain to its own driver-private domain structure (container_of). If the parent belongs to a different driver, this is a type confusion leading to out-of-bounds/invalid memory access in the kernel.

suggested_fix: Reject parents whose domain was not allocated by the same IOMMU ops before calling into the driver, e.g. extend the check to `if (parent->auto_domain || !parent->nest_parent || parent->common.domain->owner != ops) return ERR_PTR(-EINVAL);`. This ensures the driver only receives parent domains of its own type.
